name: the rule: attack
note: A unit bears on a square (FIDE 3.1-3.7's geometry, legality aside: a pinned unit still attacks): the spec's attack_by (the unit of a kind and colour on a square, its line stopped at the first unit, the knight's jump, the king's step, the pawn's diagonal) is the kernel's Chess.pieceAttacks of that unit on every position, with no hypothesis (Ideas.LegalEquiv.attackBy_iff); attack and attacked follow (attack_iff, attacked_iff); the regression of plan 76.4a reads its truth through the kernel and its derivation through its clauses.
